messages:
Nina Park: Hey team, my April 15 paystub shows both CA and WA withholding. I updated Rippling to WA as my new state effective 2026-04-10 after a short relocation. My employer address stayed the same. Can payroll split the Apr 1-15 run so CA covers Apr 1-9 and WA covers Apr 10-15? Payroll ref: RUN-7722.

People Ops: Thanks Nina. We'll need proof of move (utility or rental agreement) and the Rippling relocation record. @Samir can you confirm the effective date?

Samir Patel: Relocation effective 2026-04-10 in Rippling. No docs uploaded yet. Note WA has no state income tax but does have Paid Family & Medical Leave (PFML) and different UI rates. Which deductions do you want prorated?

Nina Park: Please prorate state income withholding and SDI/PFML where applicable. For WA just PR tax adjustments if any, but WA should have no state income tax. Also want to ensure this doesn't cause duplicate unemployment withholding.

People Ops: Understood. Send proof to payroll@redwood.com and CC People Ops. We'll open an adjustment ADJ-3344 and coordinate with Compensation if wages need reclassification for UI.

Payroll Bot: Adjustment created: ADJ-3344 for RUN-7722. Processing ETA: 3 business days. Choose refund method: "next-regular" or "off-cycle".

Nina Park: Next-regular please.

Comp Team: FYI, if the move changed your work state for payroll tax nexus we may need to update employer tax accounts. We'll review ADJ-3344 and flag any state employer-side changes.

Payroll Bot: ADJ-3344 processed. Adjustment record ADJ-2026-04-3344. CA withheld reduced by $121.17; PFML deduction for WA not applicable, so no additional deduction. Refund posted on 2026-04-30 pay.

Nina Park: Confirmed refund and updated stub: "State Allocation Correction - CA" $121.17. All looks correct, thanks.

People Ops: Closing ADJ-3344. We'll monitor year-to-date totals and issue a W-2C at year-end only if totals materially change; otherwise we'll reconcile on the W-2. If you'd like an earlier review let us know.

Code refs:
RUN-7722
ADJ-3344
ADJ-2026-04-3344
